name: Putradyne Corporis, Chaos Lord

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 1 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and options for Actions from Space Marine Implants.

abilities.text: Plague-touched Combi-Flamer: on a successful hit, reduce the AR of the target's armour by 1.

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this round.

abilities.name: Death to the False Emperor!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to Charge, gaining +2 bonus dice to the attack Test.

determination: Disgustingly Resilient: You do not need to spend Ruin to roll Determination for this Threat. Roll 7d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: Printed Strength is 5(9)*, stored 9 (Powered included, as Core prints a single armoured value); the asterisk (also on Powered 4*) has no footnote on the page. Story text: suffers Withered and Enduring Life; if slain before he ascends, his corpse revives as a Chaos Spawn, then is truly dead. A named Chaos Space Marine Champion, cf. chaos-space-marine.
